specs.Camera-wiki: Canon Sure Shot Z90W/Prima Super 90 Wide/Autoboy EPO
specs.镜头: 28–90 mm ƒ/4,5–9,9 (7 elements/6 groups) with two aspheric elements.
specs.对焦: Hybrid autofocus, 0,6 m to infinity (0,45 m in macro mode).
specs.曝光测光: Programmed exposure from 2 s, ƒ/4,5 to 1/640 s, ƒ/14,2 (wide); 2 s, ƒ/9,9 to 1/350 s, ƒ30 (tele). Exposure compensation +/- 1,5 EV.
specs.感光度: Set in whole stops ISO 25–3200 using DX coded films. Non-DX films default at ISO 25.
specs.闪光灯: Built-in pop-up flash max range at ISO 100 3,7 m (wide) to 7,4 m (tele). Auto/forced/off/slow sync modes with red-eye reduction lamp.
